summary: Inspected all 7 listed files. LeanFrontier.lean is a pure import aggregator (only imports + module docstring, zero declarations). All 6 mathematical files have multiple theorems/definitions. LeanFrontier.lean qualifies under FILTER-007 as import-only but the previous review (RRV-06e919455fef-r2) kept it primary-eligible because the auxiliary navigation channel is not verified end-to-end.
